title: Rick Ross Huh
blurb: An ad-lib so heavy it functions as punctuation. Rick Ross deploys his huh like a stamp rather than a word. It does not modify the line, it authorises it, and that authority survives being lifted clean out of the music. The grunt lands like boss approval on anything at all — an outfit reveal, a business move, a plate of food photographed from above. One syllable, immense gravity, no argument available. Press it after any statement and the statement becomes roughly forty per cent more official than it was.
